name: permissions.allow
description: List exact Cursor Agent operations permitted by the CLI configuration.

examples.explanation: Allow the exact Shell(ls) operation in project configuration.

when_to_use: Use to persist narrow, reviewed operation allowances.
when_not_to_use: Do not use broad permission rules where an exact operation is sufficient.

conditions: Permission entries are exact strings; project configuration supports permissions only.

name: approvalMode
description: Persist allowlist, auto-review, or unrestricted approval behavior for Cursor Agent CLI.

examples.explanation: Use allowlist-based command approval by default.

when_to_use: Use to set the normal approval posture for local sessions.
when_not_to_use: Do not choose unrestricted mode as a convenience default in untrusted repositories.

conditions: Supported values are allowlist, auto-review, and unrestricted.

name: sandbox.mode
description: Persist the sandbox-mode override used by Cursor Agent CLI.

examples.explanation: Persist a sandbox mode supported by the installed CLI.

when_to_use: Use when the CLI should consistently start with one supported sandbox behavior.
when_not_to_use: Use the interactive sandbox controls for a temporary session change.

conditions: Valid mode values depend on the installed CLI and policy.
